project.name: Acme App
project.summary: Example TypeScript product repository used as an engineering-baseline fixture with a projected constitution, machine-readable project facts, and a conformance entrypoint.

goals: Serve as the example product repository on the Sylphx engineering baseline with a projected constitution, machine-readable project facts, and a working conformance entrypoint.
Keep repository-local instructions compact and derived from the active Skills runtime so agents and owners share one instruction authority.
nonGoals: Owning product capabilities beyond the example fixture surface.
Maintaining a second instruction authority or resurrecting the predecessor layout.

owns.name: Repository engineering baseline
owns.description: Runtime constitution projection, project identity and manifest, and the conformance entrypoint that define how agents and owners operate this repository.

doesNotOwn: Sylphx skills catalog, runtime constitution, and organization-wide engineering policy.
Live deployment, credentials, or package publication surfaces.
forbiddenCouplings: Any second instruction authority or restored predecessor layout inside this repository.

delivery.terminalBoundary: Source landing on main with the conformance check green; this fixture has no package release or deployment boundary.

gaps.description: No product code exists in the fixture yet, so canonical code architecture conformance cannot be evidenced on the current candidate.
gaps.exitCondition: Real product code lands and satisfies the canonical engineering architecture with behavior tests.
